messages:
maria: Hey - noticed telemetry showing some prefixes with simultaneous OWNER=shard-12 and OWNER=shard-7 for a ~2s window during last night's canary. Anyone else seeing this?
aj: saw alerts earlier this morning, yeah. was that the blue/green handoff? saw lease churn on shard-12 around 03:14 UTC.
deploy-bot: PREFIX_HANDOFF start prefix=abc123 from=shard-12 to=shard-7 ts=2026-03-19T03:14:05Z
lee: probable race in the handshake -> we mark owner on ack vs on lease_apply, so if the sequencer ack path duplicates or is delayed both shards may emit owner metrics.
ravi: can we repro in the prefetctest harness? i can try to simulate packet loss on the ack path. need the event id though.
sara: grabbing logs from the canary span, pasting minimal snippet below (sensitive fields redacted):
```
[03:14:05.123] shard-12 INFO handshake: lease_granted prefix=abc123 lease_id=lk-54 ack_sent
[03:14:05.124] shard-7 INFO handshake: on_owner_mark prefix=abc123 owner=shard-7 handshake_id=hn-992
[03:14:06.300] shard-12 INFO handshake: commit_ack prefix=abc123 commit=true
[03:14:06.325] shard-12 INFO metric_emit: owner_change prefix=abc123 owner=shard-12
```
aj: interesting - owner_change emitted by shard-12 after commit even though shard-7 already marked owner earlier. seems like we emit on both events.
maria: short-term mitigation: gate owner-change telemetry emission on a handshake_committed flag (only emit when commit=true), and add a metric 'owner_conflict_detected' when two different owners appear within a small window.
lee: tradeoff: if commit is delayed we might hide a real bug where two shards think they're owner. to be safe add an alert for owner_change frequency + a dedupe window rather than outright dropping events.
ravi: alternate low-risk approach: add handshake_id to metrics and dedupe in the metric pipeline for a 5s sliding window (pipeline-level change, no runtime gating). less invasive.
sara: ops notes: dashboards consume the owner histogram to compute prefix residency heatmaps. dropping events will distort short-term views. pipeline dedupe sounds safer for dashboards. also we should mute noisy alert while we test. :thumbsup: 
aj: i can throw up a small PR for runtime gating (feature-flagged) to test in canary, mark emits only on commit; will add feature flag and telemetry to opt-in.
ravi: i'll add dedupe logic to the metrics processor and a counter for suppressed_events so we can see how many events we hide.
sara: i'll mute the owner-dup alert and update the dashboard panels to show suppressed_events.
deploy-bot: PREFIX_HANDOFF end prefix=abc123 to=shard-7 ts=2026-03-19T03:14:07Z
maria: thanks all. Action list: 1) aj - PR for feature-flagged commit-gate telemetry, 2) ravi - pipeline dedupe + suppressed counter, 3) sara - mute alert + dashboard patch. let's reconvene tomorrow 09:30 UTC to verify post-canary metrics.
aj: picking this up now, aiming for a small canary tomorrow.
ravi: will have pipeline change staged by EOD.
sara: dashboard change done, alert muted, will unmute after validation.
maria: closing loop here. if anyone sees another double-owner case, drop the raw logs in this thread. :pray:
